source: {0}unifont{/0} resolves font metadata from a provider. It ships the {1}, {2}, {3}, {4}, {5}, {6} and {7} providers, and you can write your own against the same interface. Source at {8}unjs/unifont{/8}.
text: {0}unifont{/0} löst Schriftart-Metadaten von einem Provider auf. Es bringt die Provider {1}, {2}, {3}, {4}, {5}, {6} und {7} mit, und du kannst eigene Provider für dieselbe Schnittstelle schreiben. Den Quellcode findest du unter {8}unjs/unifont{/8}.
